title: Zone Boosts
description:
A race track is split into `n` zones numbered `0` to `n - 1`, all starting at speed bonus `0`. Each entry of `boosts` is `[from, to, amount]`: every zone from `from` through `to` (inclusive) gets `amount` added to its bonus. Amounts can be negative.

After all boosts, return `[bestBonus, firstZone]`: the highest bonus on the track and the lowest-numbered zone that has it. The largest test has 100,000 zones and 15,000 boosts.
